jobs_results.title: Especialista Big Data
jobs_results.description:
En NTT Data Murcia seguimos en proceso de expansión y apostando por los profesionales más cualificados, tanto locales como más allá de nuestra Región. Buscamos talento, ofreciendo teletrabajo desde el primer día y con todas las ventajas que supone formar parte de una de las mayores compañías de desarrollo de software a nivel mundial.

Toma nota, porque esto es sólo el principio:

- Apostamos por la estabilidad laboral ofreciendo contratación indefinida desde el primer día.

- Tú decides hacia dónde quieres orientar tu carrera profesional, pudiendo escoger entre la especialización tecnológica o la gestión de personas.

- Diversas opciones de flexibilidad horaria para que puedas conciliar tu vida personal y laboral.

- Acceso a formaciones adaptadas a las necesidades reales del centro. Ponemos a tu disposición cursos tanto de desarrollo de competencias técnicas como transversales, para desarrollar proyectos de una manera más eficaz.

Por último, dentro de NTT DATA creemos en la fuerza... de la diversidad y la inclusión, reconociendo que cada persona aporta una perspectiva única e invaluable a nuestro equipo. Por tanto, trabajamos para eliminar barreras y promover oportunidades equitativas para el crecimiento profesional, asegurando el tener acceso a las mismas posibilidades de desarrollo.

Requisitos:

Experiencia y conocimientos en lenguajes de programación Scala, Java o Python (PySpark) implementados sobre el framework de procesamiento distribuido Spark.

· Valorable nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2).

· Capacidad de análisis, diseño y desarrollo de soluciones de tratamiento del dato.

· Mantenimiento de la interlocución con miembros del proyecto como parte del soporte en la definición e implementación de requisitos.

· Valoraremos experiencia en la gestión y liderazgo de equipos de trabajo

jobs_results.title: Analista de Datos
jobs_results.location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
jobs_results.description:
beBee Professionals, empresa líder en el sector de la tecnología, busca un Analista de Datos para unirse a su equipo en Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

Estamos buscando a un profesional con una sólida formación en ciencias de la computación, estadística o matemáticas, con experiencia en el análisis de datos y conocimiento de herramientas de análisis de datos.

Como Analista de Datos, tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un entorno de vanguardia, desarrollando soluciones innovadoras para nuestros clientes.
Serás responsable de recopilar, limpiar, transformar y analizar datos para ayudar a nuestros clientes a tomar decisiones informadas.

Nuestros Analistas de Datos tienen la oportunidad de trabajar con una variedad de herramientas de análisis de datos, incluyendo SQL, Python, R y Tableau.
Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con un equipo de profesionales de alto nivel, desarrollando soluciones innovadoras para nuestros clientes.

Si estás buscando una oportunidad para desarrollar tus... habilidades en el análisis de datos, esta es tu oportunidad. Únete a nuestro equipo de beBee Professionals y ayúdanos a transformar el mundo de la tecnología

jobs_results.company_name: Fundación Carlos Simón para la Investigación en Salud de ...
jobs_results.description: IPREMOM is a FemTech company created to translate our scientific knowledge into molecular tests developed for the early diagnosis of gestational diseases such as preeclampsia.Our main activity is to provide innovative solutions that protect women and their children from pregnancy-related complications. We want to create a world where pregnant women do not fear for their health.IPREMOM's scientists are experts in obstetrics, biotechnology, and computational biology with a passion for improving maternal and fetal health.We are seeking a Computational Biologist to lead the data analysis tasks developed by iPremom, as Data Science Lead, forming part of the computational biology research team at the Carlos Simon Foundation. The candidate will focus on extracting meaningful information from extensive RNA sequencing data from human subjects, implementing predictive models from RNA sequencing data, and creating a platform of pipelines to support them. The candidate will collaborate with... scientists, other professionals, and collaborators from various national and international institutions to translate the results into novel applications.Requirements:Master's degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, bioinformatics, biostatistics, or another related fieldFive or more years of experience (Ph.D. is a plus) manipulating data sets and building statistical models in bioinformatics or any computational/quantitative biology field.Broad experience in designing and building scalable data pipelines to reach data-driven scientific conclusions.Proficiency in statistical computer languages (Python, R) and scripting in Linux, Bash, and high-performance computing resourcesKnowledge of resource management with SLURMKnowledge of RNA sequencing-based transcriptomics analysis (e.g., normalization methods, differentially expressed genes, and feature selection for machine learning methods)Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (e.g., clustering, decision tree learning, and artificial neural networks) and their real-world advantages/drawbacksKnowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (e.g., regression, properties of distributions, and statistical testing) and experience with applicationsVersion and project management with GitHubExperience in organizing results in reports or notebooks (e.g., Rmarkdown, Quarto, or Jupyter)Ability to organize workloads and manage competing priorities.Resolve, dynamism, and strong problem-solving skills.Desirable skills:Management, leadership, and team supervisionKnowledge of pregnancy complications and other somatic conditionsKnowledge of modern biological data warehouses (SRA, GEO)Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS preferred)Additional skills:Drive to learn and master innovative technologies and techniques from next-generation sequencing applications.Experience visualizing/presenting data to collaborators.Excellent written/verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.Professional level ability in Spanish and EnglishFast learnerResponsibilities:Lead and manage a team of data scientists, data engineers, and other professionals involved in data analysis.Oversee the entire lifecycle of data science projects, from problem identification to solution implementation and impact and technical decision-making.Maintenance, management, and analysis of proprietary and public RNA sequencing datasets from human subjects in the diagnostic area of women's and reproductive healthRNA jobs_results.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
The Opportunity

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will be joining our Analytics department working on a hybrid basis in Madrid. This role requires a high degree of proficiency in both Spanish and English and we would invite you to submit your application in English.

You will play a crucial role in helping us achieve our goals and deliver success on behalf of our customers by building advanced statistical models and algorithms that infer and predict individual customer behaviours in real-time, based on retail, online and ecommerce transaction data.

We are experiencing a continued period of great success winning big deals with customers in Latin America, as well as across the EMEA region. This has been a big factor in our decision to build an Analytics presence in Spain to support our customers. For this role you will be working with global customers that require periodic work outside of standard hours (evening work) and international travel around once a quarter.

Day to Day
•... Applying analytical theory to diverse real-world problems on large and dynamic datasets
• Generating integral work products from project kick-off through to live deployment
• Contributing to the development of statistical models and algorithms for integration within Featurespace products
• End-to-end processing and modelling of large customer data sets
• Producing materials to feedback analytic output to customers (reports, presentations, visualizations)
• Working collaboratively with customers to develop and optimize models tailored to their data
• Evaluating and improving analytical results on live systems
• Developing an understanding of industry data structures and processes
• Working with engineering/development teams to support and enhance the analytical infrastructure
• Testing analytical models and their integration within the ARIC platform

About you

Must haves:
• Good degree in a scientific or numerate discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience
• Strong, clear, concise written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish
• Evidence of interest in machine learning
• Experience in utilising statistical models and analytical algorithms in software
• Experience using Python, Java, R or another major programming language for data analysis, machine learning or algorithm development
• Technical and analytical skills with the ability to pick up new technologies and concepts quickly
• Problem-solving skills (especially in data-centric applications)
• Strong communication skills
• Ability to manage and prioritise personal workload

Great to haves:
• Exposure to the handling of large, diverse, real-world data sets
• Experience working in a Linux command line environment
• Experience using SQL to analyse data
• Experience with version control software and workflows (e.g. git)

Equal Opportunities

Here at Featurespace we are committed to being a place of equality, inclusion and respect to provide a safe environment for you to bring your authentic self to work. We know that we gain as much strength from our differences as we do our similarities. We value diversity and are dedicated to listening and learning from each other to build and maintain a positive and productive culture. We appreciate this will be an ever-evolving focus for the business to ensure everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging

jobs_results.title: Analista de Base de Datos Oracle
jobs_results.description:
NETCheck es una compañía especializada en consultoría y soluciones tecnológicas en entornos SAP, Microsoft, Open Source, Big Data, Ciberseguridad, BI e Inteligencia Artificial.

Somos Microsoft Partner, con certificaciones: Gold en DevOps, Data Platform, Application Development y Application Integration, y certificación Silver en Cloud Platform.

Desde el 2003 somos Service Partner de SAP .

A lo largo de 22 años, hemos desarrollado proyectos para más de 100 compañías, tanto del sector público como del sector privado, en más de 15 países, incorporando en nuestros proyectos las mejores prácticas del sector.

Descripción de la oferta

¡Únete al equipo NETCheck!

¡Estamos buscando un nuevo miembro para nuestro equipo de Analista de Bases de Datos Oracle en NETCheck! Si eres una persona apasionada por Oracle y te gustaría formar parte de una empresa líder en tecnología, ¡esta es tu oportunidad!

Descripción del puesto:
• Analista de BBDD Oracle
• España
• Teletrabajo
• Indefinido a tiempo... completo

¿Por qué unirte a NETCheck?
• Ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Oportunidad de crecimiento, formación y desarrollo profesional.
• Proyectos innovadores en el campo de la tecnología y la transformación digital.
• Compromiso con el bienestar y la satisfacción de los empleados.
• Retribución flexible.

Requisitos

Imprescindible:
• Experiencia laboral en el mundo IT de, al menos, 5 años.
• Experiencia de 3 años en proyectos IT realizando labores de desarrollo, análisis y diseño técnico, desde la base de datos con Oracle.

¡Si crees que tienes lo que buscamos y estás listo para unirte a nuestro equipo, envíanos tu cv! ¡Esperamos conocerte pronto

jobs_results.title: DATA Scientist- Supply Chain
jobs_results.description:
At the SEAT:CODE we are constantly looking for talented people willing to join our projects. Our start-up environment is very open minded, we love to test and implement new ideas. If you think you are ready to enjoy your work and be part of our big family, we invite you to keep reading what we think it could be a good fit for our current needs 😊.

The Data Scientist role 🤔
• Develop solutions using a range of data science techniques
• Implement and understand a range of data science techniques and be able to develop models including machine learning
• Collaborate with the team to develop data science solutions according to business needs
• Perform analytics on data
• Able to recognise and exploit business opportunities to ensure more efficient and effective performance of organisations
• Develop data science solutions that are fit for purpose, resilient, scalable and future-proof, to meet user needs
• Help team to achieve their goals and be aligned to business needs.

About The Team... 🤗
• Our technical Team loves to deliver really well-crafted solutions at decent speed. We love tech so we really give great attention to the technology (Technology as first class Citizen)
• We know that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can do big things.
• We like to measure everything, so we are always improving, for that we use the best tools on the market such as Datadog.
• Finally, we promote a culture of no blame, trust, and learning, and we support the mantra “if it hurts do it more often” so good CI and CD are really key for us.

What We Offer 🤩
• Possibility to work remotely within Spain (you can work from any city of Spain 😎)
• 2.000€ per year in social benefits to choose from: restaurant, kindergarten, health Insurance, private insurance, fuel, transportation, gym pass, cleaning services, WIFI, Holaluz contract, etc.
• 2.000€ per year in trainings
• Free language courses
• Daily Snacks: We try to promote healthy living habits. You will find in our canteen many nuts, fresh fruit, salads, ...
• Flexible working hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance.
• Short Fridays
• 26 days for your vacations
• Best technology for your needs
• Nice located offices in Poblenou

Minimum Requirements

What we are expecting from you 🥰
• At least 3 years of experience working with Python and SQL.
• At least 3 years of experience working with Industrial optimization and simulation projects.
• Experience with AWS services like Sagemaker and S3 at least. Glue and lambda knowledge would be a plus
• Knowledge on Git
• Research background
• Methodical and logical approach along with creativity when approaching a problem
• Knowledge on how to apply statistical methods including exploratory analysis and statistical testing to a specific data set
• Be able to obtain conclusions from a data set
• Able to log, analyse and manage problems to identify and implement the appropriate solution
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to identify and communicate data driven insights in a clear and effective manner
• Curiosity and thirst for knowledge
• Advocate for feedback
• Actively pursue improving skills
• Collaborate with others for learning and achieving goals together
• Generative AI
• Occasional availability to work at the offices in Martorell

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Join our dynamic consulting teams at Globalpraxis and embark on a thrilling journey towards business excellence. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about leveraging data science to unlock the full potential of top FMCG businesses. As a Data Scientist, you will be a key part of our consulting teams and fully-embedded to the project role.

Details:
• Start date: ASAP
• Location: Barcelona, Spain

Responsibilities: As an integral part of our project teams, you will collaborate closely with our experts to tackle diverse data challenges and immerse yourself in the daily operations of the project. Your key responsibilities will include, within each project:
• Acquiring, cleansing, and standardizing large-scale datasets.
• Conducting in-depth analyses of complex business scenarios.
• Designing and implementing powerful predictive algorithms for various scenarios.
• Generating actionable insights and user-friendly reports that empower our clients to harness the true... potential of their data.
• Lead other analysts in more junior positions.

Requirements: To thrive in this role, we expect you to have the following qualifications:
• At least 2 years of demonstrable experience in data analytics / data science.
• Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering.
• Proficiency in English and Spanish.
• Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python.
• Knowledge and/or experience in PowerBI is considered a plus.
• Experience working with relational databases, including strong SQL query-building skills.

Desired Skills: In addition to the specific qualifications, we value the following skills and attributes:
• Strong analytical skills and a knack for problem-solving.
• Excellent architectural thinking to develop innovative solutions.
• Structured and critical thinking abilities to approach complex challenges.
• Strong interpersonal skills and alignment with our company culture.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a multicultural environment.

Globalpraxis is a renowned international consulting firm known for our blend of academic expertise and dedicated consultants who foster objectivity, creativity, and intellectual rigor. With a strong presence in consumer goods, telecommunications, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and service industries, our strategies in consumer engagement, distribution channels, and customer-centricity have propelled our clients toward global success. With a global reach spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and the United States, we combine analytical rigor with local insights to become the perfect partner for businesses worldwide.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a lasting impact on businesses and launch your career forward. Apply now to be a part of our exciting and vibrant team at Globalpraxis

jobs_results.title: Checkout Data Analyst (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Checkout Data Analyst to join our Checkout team in Barcelona (hybrid), which is passionate about data, automation, analysis and innovation and loves to work in a collaborative and agile environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 5.4M members in Prime

16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches

1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age

We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel... subscription program.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Checkout Data Analyst in the Checkout team you will be in charge of:
• Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights
• Own team metrics identifying the drivers of over and underperformance and providing data driven recommendations for how we can improve the KPIs performance
• Turn business questions into functional analysis, extract relevant and actionable insights working with data from many different data sources using SQL/BQ and work with your stakeholders to make them happen
• Elaborate business cases to support strategic product decisions
• Design and execute measurement experiments; Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the business stakeholders
• Create dashboards and tracking: ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes that depend on it to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs, as well as, foster data-driven decision making across the organisation. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage relevant data
• Contribute to the delivery of strategic projects: participate in the delivery of key initiatives, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes. Work together with stakeholders in the execution of the projects, giving support from the analytical and business side

What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:
• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)
• Experience in a role with strong analytical component
• Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data; python/R programming skills and experience with Looker Studio, Power BI will be valued
• Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with Microsoft and Google Office package (Excel, etc.)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
• Strong organisational and communication skills
• Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment
• A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!
• Business Proficiency in English

What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:
• A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
• Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
• Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
• Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
• Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
• Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

I f you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation

jobs_results.title: Master Data
jobs_results.description:
Estamos seleccionando un Master Data para nuestro departamento de Control de Gestión Industrial.La persona seleccionada se encargará de cargar y mantener los datos maestros actualizados en nuestro ERP, garantizando el proceso y los flujos de información asociados.

Buscamos un perfil que aporte experiencia en implantación de SAP, carga de datos maestros y seguimiento del arranque.

¿Tienes experiencia como Master Data? ¿Te consideras una personas proactiva, comunicativa, organizada y metódica?

Te encargarás de:
• Ejecutar el alta y la gestión de los artículos en el maestro de materiales del ERP.
• Ejecutar el alta de las nuevas listas de materiales.
• Mantener, actualizar y gestionar las listas de materiales, tanto las nuevas como las versiones existentes.
• Asignar y mantener los datos necesarios para el correcto etiquetado y arte final de componentes y palets, relacionda con cada uno de los clientes.

Se trata de una posición estable, ofrecemos incorporación en una empresa en pleno... proceso de expansión y que apuesta por las personas.

Requisitos:
• Valorable formación superior: Lic.Documentación, Ing.Organización Industrial, otras titulaciones afines. Valorable formación postgrado tipo Master SAP.
• Imprescindible aportar experiencia previa como Master Data en empresas sector industrial.
• ERP SAP.
• Nivel EXCEL alto
